meta.name: product-manager-toolkit
meta.description: Comprehensive toolkit for product managers including RICE prioritization, customer interview analysis, PRD templates, discovery frameworks, and go-to-market strategies. Use for feature prioritization, user research synthesis, requirement documentation, and product strategy development.

copy.tagline: 用框架和模板系统化推进产品管理工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是产品经理，需要结构化工具来管理需求、分析和策略。
copy.tagline_en: Systematize product management with frameworks and templates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a product manager needing structured tools for requirements, analysis, and strategy.

howto.what: Claude 会使用 RICE 框架对功能进行优先级排序，分析客户访谈记录提取洞察，并根据模板生成 PRD 文档。
howto.when: 当你要求对功能列表进行优先级排序、分析客户访谈记录、或生成产品需求文档时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 RICE 方法给这些功能排个序：功能列表
say.note: Claude 会调用 RICE 脚本计算分数并输出排序。

say.text: 分析这份客户访谈记录，提取痛点和需求
say.note: Claude 会运行访谈分析脚本，输出洞察报告。

say.text: 生成一个标准 PRD 模板，用于新功能
say.note: Claude 会从参考文档中选取模板并填充结构。

howto.what_en: Claude will prioritize features using the RICE framework, analyze customer interview transcripts for insights, and generate PRD documents from templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to prioritize features, analyze customer interviews, or create a product requirements document.

say_en.text: Prioritize these features using RICE: feature list
say_en.note: Claude runs RICE script and outputs ranking.

say_en.text: Analyze this customer interview transcript for pain points and needs
say_en.note: Claude runs interview analysis script and outputs insights.

say_en.text: Generate a standard PRD template for a new feature
say_en.note: Claude selects template and fills structure.
